answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 11655 Country: India Title: Jazakallah khair..My question is that if a person standing in the first or in the middle row in salah,passes the air unwillingly,what should he do?should he come out of the row to make wudhu or continue his salah and then make wudhu to complete the salah? please advise. Question: Jazakallah khair..My question is that if a person standing in the first or in the middle row in salah,passes the air unwillingly,what should he do?should he come out of the row to make wudhu or continue his salah and then make wudhu to complete the salah? please advise. Answer ID: 11655 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 720/426=H/1430) He should leave salah as soon as the wind passes. If he can go back easily, he should perform wudhu again and offer salah anew. But, if it is difficult to go back, he should leave salah and sit quietly. Later, when he finds time, should go out, perform wudhu and salah again. He should not continue salah after passing the wind. There is one way of rejoining the salah, but it has some details, it is better for common people to perform salah again and if the imam is still in salah he should join the salah as masbooq and perform the remaining rak?ah after the salam of imam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
